counter.independence_argument: The clock's tick_count is incremented inside SimulationClock::advance (clock.rs:96), called from advance_simulation_clock in PreUpdate, draining the clock's own f64 accumulator with the max_ticks_per_frame cap and the zeroing branch at clock.rs:100-102. The step counter is a separate resource that advance never touches. It is incremented by count_physics_step, a system inside Avian's PhysicsSchedule, which Avian's run_physics_schedule (.patches/avian3d-0.7.0/src/schedule/mod.rs:235-276) runs once per fixed tick of FixedPostUpdate, only when Time<Physics> has a non-zero delta (not paused) and the Kinematics domain run condition allows PhysicsSystems::StepSimulation (engine/src/plugins/physics_plugin.rs:90-93). FixedPostUpdate's tick count comes from Bevy's Time<Fixed> accumulator over Time<Virtual>, not from SimulationClock; SimulationClock.time_scale does not reach Avian at all (Avian's speed is PhysicsService.time_scale, physics_plugin.rs:802-805). The two counts therefore come from different schedules, different accumulators and different scale factors, and disagree whenever the clock's cap or compression and the fixed loop diverge. A catch-up frame that runs FixedPostUpdate N times runs PhysicsSchedule N times and increments the counter N times.
